crossRefs.note: They made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.
Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that had come on him, they each came from his own place: Eliphaz…

parallels.note: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

people.name: Hadad
people.line: A son of Ishmael, Abraham's son.

people.name: Kedemah
people.line: A son of Ishmael; Nodab, a Hagrite tribe

people.name: Naphish
people.line: Son of Ishmael, defeated by Reubenites, Gadites, and Manassites.

people.name: Tema
people.line: Son of Ishmael, associated with an Arabian city
